title: HVT escort of sealed 'mystery boxes' on classified flights

tellings.quote: these targets most of the time were like sealed containers. Um, we called them mystery boxes.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once flew to retrieve a UFO, says that in the 1990s he escorted secret cargo on classified flights. The military called this cargo "high-value targets". He says that most of the time these were sealed containers that the crews called "mystery boxes", and they were never told what was inside. Barber tells it as his own experience, as part of how he came to carry things he was not meant to know about.
